name: giant frog
desc: Giant Frog is a CR 0.25 beast.

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: standing leap
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]).

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} swallows a [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=IPD9mDjKJEXc2uMQ]] target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn't Grappled but has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions, and it has &Reference[Total Cover] against attacks and other effects outside the frog. While swallowing the target, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't use Bite, and if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, the swallowed target is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. At the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn, the swallowed target takes [[/damage 2d4 acid average]] damage. If that damage doesn't kill it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} disgorges it, causing it to exit &Reference[Prone apply=false].
